name: TLL OS Identity Root
description: Root of identity for TLL OS engineering ecosystem. This file defines the identity trust anchor. Identities are verified by public key signatures, not by file contents alone.

trust_model.note: Ed25519 is planned for P0-15.19. Until then, identity records are self-declared and must be verified by external means (git commit author, CI logs, human confirmation).

root_authority.name: TLL OS Project Maintainers
root_authority.description: Human maintainers with commit access to aliquanhou/tllos. Final authority on Truth changes and Protocol amendments.
root_authority.verification: git commit signature + GitHub account + human confirmation
root_authority.note: This is the bootstrap root authority. Future versions may transition to a multi-signature DAO or similar mechanism.

level_0.name: anonymous
level_0.description: No identity verified. Can read Truth and Evidence, cannot submit changes.

level_1.name: observer
level_1.description: Identity verified by public key, but no track record. Can submit Issues and Proposals, cannot commit code.

level_2.name: contributor
level_2.description: Has submitted at least one verified PR that passed CI and audit. Can commit to non-core branches.

level_3.name: developer
level_3.description: Regular contributor with verified track record. Can commit to core branches (compiler, vm, runtime, stdlib). Default level for AI Agents in bootstrap phase.
level_3.note: AI Agents default to Level 3 in bootstrap phase. They can modify code and submit evidence, but cannot modify Truth or Protocol directly.

level_4.name: maintainer
level_4.description: Can merge PRs, update Truth files, and approve Protocol extensions. Cannot modify Protocol core rules (R001-R010).

level_5.name: root_maintainer
level_5.description: Can modify Protocol core rules (R001-R010) and Identity Root. Requires human confirmation + multi-signature in future versions.
level_5.note: Reserved for human maintainers. AI Agents cannot reach Level 5.

agent_identity_policy.note: AI Agents must register in agents.json before submitting changes. Their identity is verified by git commit author and CI run attribution.
